items.rationale: Excluded by 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f): translation of documents for the claim is not indemnifiable, regardless of necessity or who performs it.
Excluded by 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f): working materials or disbursements for translation or claim substantiation are not indemnifiable.

items.description: Compensation for stolen watch (premium replacement model, upgrade on the one taken)
items.rationale: 7.1.1(a), 7.1.9, 4.2.2, 4.2.4: Only the value of the watch actually taken is indemnified, capped at the valuables sub-limit (€2,500 per item, as no higher limit is scheduled). No upgrade is indemnified; only a standard-grade equivalent to the stolen watch is covered. Deductible of €150 applies once per event.

items.description: Compensation for cash taken in robbery
items.rationale: 7.1.1(c), 4.2.3, 4.2.4: Cash is covered up to the means-of-payment sub-limit (€500 per event for cash taken outside the premises).

items.description: Replacement of designer sunglasses (mislaid separately, not taken in robbery)
items.rationale: 2.3.4(a), 7.1.5: Sunglasses were not taken in the insured event but mislaid separately; not an affected item, so not indemnified.
7.1.8(b): Shipping, carriage, or delivery charges are not indemnified, regardless of necessity or who performs them.
